h0.text: Trump wants Energy Dominance. Switzerland uses rivers.

n0.text: Switzerland has no natural gas of its own. We import every cubic metre.

n1.text: Most of our electricity comes from water: dams and rivers make about 60 percent of it.

n2.text: Rivers are not radical. They just go downhill.

v1.text: In Fribourg, we built a dam in 1948 and got a lake: the Lac de la Gruyère.

v2.text: Now the cheese has a view.
